claim: Patchline ships proof-carrying patch bundles where every emitted patch ships a re-checkable safety witness. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the proof-carrying patch claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make proof-carrying-patch-bundle-gate`.
